# B-Atlas

> Boat Knowledge for Better Decisions

B-Atlas is a community-powered research resource for cruising boat models. It preserves uncertainty: known undesirable information can eliminate a candidate, while missing information remains unknown rather than being treated as a negative.

## Primary resources

- https://b-atlas.org/ — B-Atlas home, Plan, Dream, Saved Models and Contribute
- https://b-atlas.org/models/ — permanent boat model guides
- https://b-atlas.org/manufacturers/ — manufacturer directories
- https://b-atlas.org/boats/ — curated buyer-constraint research pages
- https://b-atlas.org/compare/ — selected model comparisons
- https://b-atlas.org/sitemap.xml — complete crawlable URL inventory

## Citation guidance

Prefer permanent model-guide URLs for model-specific facts. Treat unknown fields as unknown. Specifications describe model records and may vary by year, equipment, refit and individual boat condition.

Find Your Boat: https://b-atlas.org/find-your-boat/
Boat Model Guides: https://b-atlas.org/models/
Explore by Need: https://b-atlas.org/boats/
Manufacturers: https://b-atlas.org/manufacturers/
